channel.description: Find the right tool at the right price.

item.title: Weber Genesis C-335E Gas Grill with Free Shipping
item.description: The Weber Genesis C-335E is a three-burner gas grill with a side burner and porcelain-enameled cast-iron cooking grates. Costco is offering it for $749.99 with free shipping, though it may be available at a lower price in stores.

item.title: DEKCO 5MP WiFi Video Doorbell with PIR Motion Detection for $72.40
item.description: The DEKCO 5MP WiFi Video Doorbell offers ultra-HD resolution, PIR motion detection, and two-way audio. It is priced at $72.40 after a $6 coupon discount, with free shipping from a US warehouse.

item.title: BCANHOME Soft-close Sliding Shower Door for $509.99
item.description: This BCANHOME semi-frameless sliding shower door measures 56–60 inches wide by 76 inches high and features a soft-close buffer damping system. It is constructed with 10 mm tempered glass, stainless steel anti-rust hardware, and an explosion-proof film for durability and safety. The door is priced at $509.99.

item.title: StonePure Freestanding Stone Bathtub with Overflow and Drain for $1299.99
item.description: This freestanding solid surface stone bathtub measures 61 by 30 inches and includes an overflow and pop-up drain. It is available for $1299.99.

item.title: BCANHOME Smart Toilet with Bidet and Auto Features for $409.99
item.description: The BCANHOME Smart Toilet includes a tankless bidet wash, auto-open lid and seat, heated seat, warm wash and dryer, soft closing, and remote control. It features a MaP 1000g powerful flush and 1.28-gallon auto dual flush. This deal is available at Wayfair for $409.99.

item.title: DESLOC C100 Plus Smart Lock with Keypad Drops to $30
item.description: The DESLOC C100 Plus is a WiFi-enabled smart door lock with a keypad and visual display, offering app remote control, support for up to 100 PIN codes, and an auto-lock feature. It is suitable for home and rental use. This deal brings the lock to $30 with free shipping.

item.title: Shintenchi 6x4 FT Outdoor Storage Shed with Window for $125.99 at Amazon
item.description: This Shintenchi outdoor storage shed offers a 6x4 ft footprint with a window and lockable single door. It is made of weather-resistant metal, suitable for storing garden tools and equipment. The shed is available at Amazon for $125.99 with free shipping.

item.title: Hummingbird Solar Lanterns from $9.72 with code
item.description: These outdoor solar lanterns feature hummingbird designs and are waterproof, suitable for garden decor. With promo code SS7UU4EM at checkout, the single-bird version is $9.72 and the hummingbird mom version is $10.99.

item.title: Echo 56V Cordless Mower with Battery and Charger Drops to $438.63
item.description: This deal bundles an Echo 56V 21-inch cordless self-propelled lawn mower with a 5.0Ah battery and charger. By adding an Echo leaf blower to the cart and returning it after purchase, the mower price drops to $438.63. Alternatively, ordering from the military store offers 10% off and free shipping if you keep both items.

item.title: Greenlee Battery Crimping Tool Priced at $5,369.10
item.description: The Greenlee E12CCXL230 is a battery-powered crimping tool designed for professional electrical work. It is currently available for $5,369.10 on Amazon. This price reflects the listed cost for the tool.

item.title: Toro Flex-Force 60V Leaf Blower $130 Off at Lowe's
item.description: The Toro Flex-Force 60V leaf blower delivers strong blowing power for yard cleanup. It is currently discounted by $130 at Lowe's, bringing the price down significantly ahead of Labor Day.

item.title: TempSpike Bluetooth Grill Thermometer Drops to $22.99 at Walmart
item.description: The TempSpike Grill Gauge is a wireless Bluetooth thermometer that monitors grill and smoker temperatures from up to 450 feet away, upgrading any grill or smoker to a smart device. This deal from Walmart.com prices it at $22.99, with free shipping available for Walmart+ members or on qualifying orders.

item.title: Milwaukee M18 FUEL PACKOUT Wet/Dry Vac and Impact Driver for $189
item.description: Home Depot offers the Milwaukee M18 FUEL PACKOUT 18V 2.5-gallon wet/dry vacuum bundled with an M18 FUEL 1/4-inch hex impact driver for $189. This tools-only deal includes free pickup or delivery and is available for today only.

item.title: Milwaukee M18 FUEL PACKOUT 2.5 Gal. Wet/Dry Vacuum with 5.0 Ah Battery $189
item.description: The Milwaukee M18 FUEL PACKOUT 2.5 Gal. Cordless Wet/Dry Vacuum is a compact, powerful vacuum that integrates with the PACKOUT system. This deal includes the vacuum and an M18 5.0 Ah battery for $189, available for ship to store and delivery.

item.title: Nuwave Grill Air Fryer Combo with Smart Probe at $99.99
item.description: The Nuwave 15.5 Q Plug-In Grill Air Fryer Oven Combo features sheath heaters, a convection system, 100 presets, and a smart probe. It is available at Woot! for $99.99.

item.title: Fragess Folding Camping Cot with Mattress Drops to $59.99 at Woot
item.description: This portable camping cot supports up to 600 pounds and includes a thick mattress, making it suitable for outdoor camping, office naps, or home use. The folding design allows for easy setup and storage. Woot is offering it for $59.99 with free shipping for Amazon Prime members.

item.title: SKIL 16-Inch String Trimmer Attachment for Multi-Head System, $56.96 at Walmart
item.description: This is a string trimmer attachment for the SKIL Multi-Head System, compatible with the PLT1500C-13 power head. It is priced at $56.96 at Walmart, with free shipping for Walmart+ members.

item.title: Royal Gourmet 30-Inch Charcoal Grill and Smoker for $99.99 at Woot
item.description: This Royal Gourmet CD2030AN is a 30-inch charcoal grill that also functions as a deluxe BBQ smoker, suitable for picnics, camping, and patio use. The deal includes free delivery from Woot, priced at $99.99.

item.title: Yale Assure Lock 2 Smart Lock with Wi-Fi and Fingerprint Access
item.description: The Yale Assure Lock 2 is a smart deadbolt with Wi-Fi connectivity, a touchscreen keypad, and fingerprint access. This deal offers the lock at a discounted price, providing secure keyless entry and remote control via a smartphone app.

item.title: Milwaukee M18 8-Tool Combo Kit with 2 Batteries and Charger for $649
item.description: This combo kit includes eight Milwaukee M18 cordless tools, two batteries, and a charger. It is available for $649 with free shipping or store pickup.

item.title: Greenworks 24V String Trimmer with 4.0Ah Battery Drops to $88
item.description: This cordless string trimmer from Greenworks runs on a 24V battery and includes 20 replacement blades. The kit, which comes with a 4.0 Ah battery, is available for $88.12 with free shipping.

item.title: Greenworks 24V Leaf Blower with Battery and Charger for $89.99
item.description: This Greenworks 24V handheld leaf blower delivers 270 CFM of air volume and comes with a 3.0 Ah battery and charger. The deal is available at Amazon for $89.99 with free shipping.

item.title: Empire 2-Piece Level Set for $19.97 at Home Depot
item.description: This set includes a 24-inch aluminum I-beam level and a 12-inch compact box level from Empire. Home Depot is offering the set for $19.97 with free shipping or free store pickup where available.

item.title: DEWALT 31-Piece Security Bit Set with Case for $14.98 at Amazon
item.description: This 31-piece DEWALT security screwdriver bit set includes a storage case and is designed for various security fasteners. The set is available for $14.98 at Amazon, with free shipping for Prime members or on orders over $35.

item.title: Lazyboi 21V Cordless Leaf Blower with 2 Batteries Drops to $59.95
item.description: The Lazyboi cordless leaf blower runs on a 21V battery and includes two batteries and a charger. It is lightweight and available in various colors. The price is $59.95, down from the regular price of $89.99.

item.title: COWAY Airmega 400 Air Purifier for Large Rooms, $388.99
item.description: The COWAY Airmega 400 Air Purifier covers up to 3,120 square feet and includes a washable pre-filter. It is currently available for $388.99.

item.title: Digital Instant Read Meat Thermometer for $9.98
item.description: This digital instant read meat thermometer provides temperature readings in about 1-2 seconds, featuring a bright backlit display for easy visibility. It is suitable for cooking and grilling, helping to ensure food is cooked to the desired doneness. The thermometer is available for $9.98.

item.title: Coleman 22' x 52" Above Ground Pool Set for $398 at Walmart
item.description: This Coleman Power Steel round above ground pool set measures 22 feet in diameter and 52 inches deep. Walmart offers it for $398 with free shipping.

item.title: House Again Bristle-Free Grill Brush and Scraper Drops to $14.99
item.description: The 18-inch House Again bristle-free BBQ grill brush and scraper is on sale for $14.99 after a $15 discount with promo code 5JOR82GI at checkout. The deal includes free shipping with Prime or on orders over $35.

item.title: Oversize Turbo Dryer Blower for Car, 670CFM, 4-Speed, LED, $39.99
item.description: This is a high-velocity blower designed for drying cars, with 670 CFM airflow and 4-speed settings. It includes a 64mm large duct and LED light, and is available for $39.99 with a promo code at checkout.
